task_title: Unify CI fixer automation around Copilot

plan_review.notes: Original centralized comment/label design was rejected. Adopted all three alternatives: default-branch trusted router with unprivileged Copilot worker; incremental cutover preserving working deterministic helpers until parity; GitHub-native serialized ownership using repository-wide per-PR Actions concurrency with queue:max and atomic dynamic-label creation. Human explicitly prohibited Azure, so no Azure dependency is used. Label is existence bit only; sticky lookup is paginated and fails closed on 0/>1; workflow-dispatch lease identifiers are non-secret within trusted-writer boundary; TTL grace exceeds queue jitter; custom-agent selection is not assumed; substantive invalid-review verdicts escalate rather than auto-resolve.
